verdict.rationale: PII detection and redaction is a fair question for a scraping API, but the evidence pack never documents any built-in PII detection, redaction, or filtering. The extract_rules and ai_query parameters only let a user pick which fields to extract. That is an adjacent building block, not automatic PII filtering before storage.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
